title: PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE REPORT AND BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the acceptance of a Fiscal Year 2025-26 California Office of Traffic…
text:
[Council File 26-1177]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE REPORT AND BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the acceptance of a Fiscal Year 2025-26 California Office of Traffic Safety grant award for the City Attorney's Alcohol and Drug Impaired Driving Vertical Prosecution Program.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. AUTHORIZE the City Attorney, or designee, to:
a. Retroactively apply for and execute the grant award agreement between the Office of Traffic Safety and the City Attorney’s Office, subject to the approval of the City Attorney.
b. Accept the grant award in the amount of $1,327,000 from the Office of Traffic Safety to support the Alcohol and Drug Impaired Driving Vertical Prosecution Program for the period of October 1, 2025 through September 30, 2026.
c. Prepare Controller instructions for any necessary technical adjustments, subject to the approval of the City Administrative Officer, and AUTHORIZE the Controller to implement the instructions.
2. AUTHORIZE the Controller to:
a. Establish a receivable within Fund No. 368, Department No. 12, in the amount of $1,327,000 from the Office of Traffic Safety.
b. Establish Appropriation Account No. 12E231 within Fund No. 368/12 in the amount of $1,327,000.
c. Transfer $208,613 from Fund No. 368/12, Account No. 12E231, Impaired Driving Prosecution to Fund No. 100/12, Account No. 001010, Salaries General, to reimburse for salary expenses.
d. Upon receipt of grant reimbursements and approval of expenses, transfer up to $473,230 from Fund No. 368/12, Account No. 12E231, Impaired Driving Prosecution to Fund No. 100/12, Revenue Source Code No. 5346, Related Cost Reimbursement – Grants, to reimburse fringe benefits and related costs during the grant period.
e. Transfer $402,294 from Fund No. 368/12, Account No. 12E231, Impaired Driving Prosecution to Fund No. 100/12, Revenue Source Code No. 5427, Reimbursement from Grants, to reimburse for salary costs incurred in 2025-26.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Administrative Officer reports that the total program cost of the Fiscal Year 2025-26 Alcohol and Drug Impaired Driving Vertical Prosecution Program is $1,327,000, which will be fully reimbursed by the California Office of Traffic Safety Grant funding. Financial policies The City Administrative Officer reports that accepting the grant and approving the statement recommendations in this report are in compliance with the City's Financial Policies as the grant funds are fully reimbursing the General Fund for grant-eligible activities.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
